name: Default
shortDescription: Slideshow web app that displays photos and videos from your Immich library on any browser, tablet or TV, with clock, weather and metadata overlays.

alerts.message: Immich Kiosk needs an existing Immich 3.2.0 or newer server and an Immich API key. Create the key in Immich under Account Settings > API Keys with the permissions listed in the installation docs, set KIOSK_IMMICH_API_KEY to it and redeploy. KIOSK_IMMICH_URL defaults to an Immich app from this catalog in the same environment; for another server set it to that server's URL. Set KIOSK_IMMICH_EXTERNAL_URL to the public Immich URL so asset links and QR codes open in a browser.
The slideshow is protected by the generated KIOSK_PASSWORD. Open the kiosk as https://<your-domain>/?password=<KIOSK_PASSWORD>.
